text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"Like I'm sayin', that's not it!
The guys from the bay run way more sharp and snappy..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At dusk. Walking through town while listening to
Jungle Pocket's street racer philosophy—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Step right up, the New Year's Grand Raffle is underway~!
The grand prize is an all-expenses-paid hot springs trip!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
1st prize is the "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!
2nd prize is "Mountain of Carrots"!
3rd prize is "Single Carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Step right up! Come try the fun, exciting lottery draw!
Hey, fierce-looking Umamusume over there, won't you give it a spin?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, a raffle? Hell yeah, I'm doing it.
You are too, right, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: "Pulling off a huge win at a time like this is what it's all about!"
choice_data_list: Yeah, I really want to pull the grand prize!
Yeah, I really want to pull the grand prize!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I hand my solitary raffle ticket to the man.
This is my one and only chance.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, a do-or-die shot, bring it on.
Having a second chance just dulls your edge.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Let's spin it, partner!
Together, you and me, we'll nail it on the first try!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: RAAAAAGHHH!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With an ear-splitting yell you'd never expect from a simple lottery,
she spins the raffle wheel. What will the result be!?

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! Congraaaatulations!!
The Grand Prize, 'Hot Springs Trip Ticket', has been won~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: I did it…… I did it……

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
I TOLD YA I DID ITTTTT!!!
FUCK YEAHHHHHHH!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A roar echoed through the shopping district.
Jungle Pocket burst with joy, and then—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"In that case, let's roll, Trainer.
We've got more shopping to do."

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
I gotta stock up on that stuff for our trip.
Come with me!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Jungle Pocket arrived at the candy aisle.
And then――

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Now, what are you gonna do, Trainer?
Which angle do we attack from?
choice_data_list: Which what?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Chocolates or snacks.
Which one are we mainly stuffing in? Huh?
choice_data_list: Wait, candy...?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Of course I am. A trip without snacks
is completely out of the question. Just so you know...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"Up to 500 yen"? Don't give me that cheap crap.
We're not little kids anymore.
choice_data_list: I see. How about some mature, spicy snacks then?
I see, then how about some spicy snacks for adults?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, whoa... isn't that being way too aggressive?
You're gonna blow a gasket and keel over, y'know?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Endure that crazy level of spice, huh...
Alright, let's give this a shot...!
choice_data_list: For now, let's go with something that lasts a while.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Shelf life? Why?
choice_data_list: Doesn't look like I can go for the time being. I've got races coming up, too.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... Right, now that you mention it...
The next goal is in March, so I can't just be goofing off.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Alright, understood. The hot springs trip will celebrate being the strongest.
Instead, today we...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Let's buy some milk chocolate on the way back to celebrate winning!
Heheh, which one should I pick!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The hot springs trip was put on hold for now.
However, having bagged the ultimate prize,
Jungle Pocket was in high spirits!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, you won 1st prize~!
The prize is a "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, sweet!
Missed the grand prize, but still scored something pretty great!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
A carrot dramatically stuck right in.
Now that's how it's gotta be.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: By the way, Trainer, is a Salisbury steak without a carrot stuck in it even allowed?
choice_data_list: ...What do you mean by ants?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Food is only good when there's toppings on it, dammit!
For example...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: I'm asking if you'd really accept curry rice that doesn't have any curry on it.
choice_data_list: That might not... be allowed.
That might not... be acceptable.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
It's a question of whether you can even call
an omelet rice without ketchup real omelet rice.
choice_data_list: Maybe even that... won't be recognized?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
I'm asking if you can seriously accept
a chocolate sundae without a chocolate stick stuck in it!
choice_data_list: That might be... a bit iffy!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
What? You won't admit it?
Even so, I will—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
It's only hype if it's got toppings on it!
If there's nothing on it, that's where it ends.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
The ultimate Salisbury steak with a carrot stabbed right into it.
Don't mind if I dig in!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Having gotten food that struck right at the center of her heart,
Jungle Pocket looked overjoyed!"

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Second prize~!!
The prize is a "Mountain of Carrots"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Oh, looks like you hit a whole bunch.
Well, at least you saved face.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Even so, there's no way I can eat this much.
Right?
choice_data_list: Yeah, that might be a bit much, even so.
Yeah, that might honestly be too much.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"In that case, let's swing by there.
Follow me."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And the place we arrived at was—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Heeey, you bastards!
I brought you some refreshments!

text_block_list.name: L/Roars Member A
text_block_list.text: Ah, Boss... or rather, Former Boss! Good work out there, Pokke-san!

text_block_list.name: L/Roars Member B
text_block_list.text:
"All those carrots!?
Whoa, you're super generous!"

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Ah, you're hungry, aren't you? Running all that way always leaves one starving at this hour.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Bite into this and keep your strength up.
Go on, dig in!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Visiting the base of the freestyle team 'L/Roars',
Jungle Pocket treated everyone with great generosity.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
3rd prize~!
The prize is "one carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Are you kidding me?!
Just one...? How cheap.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"Well, nothing we can do about it.
Guess we'll split it, Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Snap!)

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Here ya go.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Saying that, Jungle Pocket split it down the middle and gave me the bigger half.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: "Huh? What's the matter?"
choice_data_list: Why the bigger one?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Ah, sorry. Just out of habit.
I usually eat snacks together with my little sister, you see.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: I just have a habit of aiming for the bigger one, y'know?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
An unexpected side to Jungle Pocket.
It seems she has a tender, caring side for her younger sister.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Here, eat up. Not enough?
If it ain't, I'll give ya the smaller one too.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
No, or should I go buy some more?
Maybe some plushies while I'm at it...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Hm? What's wrong?
If you're bored, I can do something for ya.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Blehh-blehh-blehh, ROAAAR!
choice_data_list: No, it's fine. I'm not your little sister!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems this is how Jungle Pocket
usually dotes on her younger sister.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Too bad, you lost!
Your consolation prize is a pack of tissues~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Hey, what is the meaning of this?
Are you telling me this is all we amount to?
choice_data_list: Can't be helped...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Ah, dammit.
Well, guess I gotta figure out how to use this.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, if some punk beats you up and gives you a bloody nose,
you'd better tell me.
choice_data_list: Are you going to wipe it with that tissue?
Are you going to wipe it with that tissue?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
No, payback comes first!
Don't mess with me, dammit!
choice_data_list: Doesn't that make the tissues pointless!?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
We'll worry about that later!
If they hit us, we hit 'em right back!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Due to the disappointing result,
Jungle Pocket stayed rowdy and frustrated for a while...
